ja: 未申告drift.{0,40}(データ検知|検出)
en: (No data-driven detection of undeclared drift|does not detect undeclared drift)

criteria.name: reproduction command and correct two-seed look count

question: Do both public EP26 articles explicitly expose the minimum facts needed to distinguish the estimand, applicability boundary, measured outcomes, dependence and reproduction procedure?
unit: 12 fixed lexical criteria per language; 24 criterion-language records
acceptance: Baseline is recorded without edits. Remediation may only add or correct text required by the same frozen rubric. Passing shows lexical self-containment, not human understanding.

predictions.P1: Baseline will pass 9/12 in each language, failing dependence, primary-source link and correct two-seed look count.
predictions.P2: After rubric-preserving remediation, both languages will pass12/12.
predictions.P3: The numeric correction is24 to72 regenerated looks; recorded360 looks remain unchanged.

stop_rule: No rubric/pattern changes after baseline. Stop R3 on page/hash/source mismatch. Keep any unexpected baseline failure and do not weaken criteria.
claim_boundary: Document-content audit only. No reader was recruited; comprehension, usability, novelty, demand and independent replication remain UNKNOWN. Regex presence does not prove that a reader interprets a claim correctly.

literature_positioning.steady_state_output: Existing work constructs confidence intervals for steady-state means and sequential run lengths under steady-state assumptions.
literature_positioning.change_detection: E-detectors provide sequential changepoint detection with false-alarm/delay guarantees, but do not by themselves label post-change multiserver queue stability.
literature_positioning.msj_stability: Existing two-class FCFS work derives exact analytical stability regions, not finite-window claim-audit interfaces.
literature_positioning.candidate_contribution: A benchmark/audit artifact joining known stability labels, observation contracts, abstention and applicability refusal; novelty still unestablished.

development: Rubric written after EP26 publication but before baseline execution. Local hash/clock only; no external timestamp. Current page was read to design a claim-completeness rubric, so this is not a blinded test.
